mapper.insert: INSERT INTO test_case_run (id, case_id, workspace_id, status, note, step_results, environment, bug_task_id, plan_id, executed_by, executed_by_user_id, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{caseId}, #{workspaceId}, #{status}, #{note}, #{stepResults}, #{environment}, #{bugTaskId}, #{planId}, #{executedBy}, #{executedByUserId}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP))
mapper.select: SELECT r.bug_task_id AS bugTaskId, c.id AS caseId, c.title AS caseTitle, c.req_id AS reqId, c.case_no AS caseNo, c.latest_status AS latestStatus FROM test_case_run r JOIN test_case c ON c.id = r.case_id AND c.workspace_id = r.workspace_id WHERE r.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND c.req_id = #{reqId} AND r.bug_task_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY r.bug_task_id, c.id, c.title, c.req_id, c.case_no, c.latest_status ORDER BY MAX(r.created_at) DESC, MAX(r.id) DESC

SELECT r.bug_task_id AS bugTaskId, c.id AS caseId, c.title AS caseTitle, c.req_id AS reqId, c.case_no AS caseNo, c.latest_status AS latestStatus FROM test_case_run r JOIN test_case c ON c.id = r.case_id AND c.workspace_id = r.workspace_id WHERE r.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND r.bug_task_id = #{bugTaskId} GROUP BY r.bug_task_id, c.id, c.title, c.req_id, c.case_no, c.latest_status ORDER BY MAX(r.created_at) DESC, MAX(r.id) DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE test_case_run SET bug_task_id = NULL WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM test_case_run WHERE case_id = #{caseId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM test_case_run WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND case_id = #{caseId}
mapper.update: UPDATE test_case_run SET bug_task_id = #{bugTaskId} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM test_case_run WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND case_id = #{caseId}
mapper.select: WITH ranked AS ( SELECT r.status AS status, r.executed_by AS executed_by, r.executed_by_user_id AS executed_by_user_id, r.environment AS environment, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.case_id ORDER BY r.created_at, r.id) AS rn FROM test_case_run r JOIN test_case c ON c.id = r.case_id AND c.workspace_id = r.workspace_id WHERE r.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND c.req_id = #{reqId} ), facts AS ( SELECT 'executor' AS dim, COALESCE(executed_by_user_id, '') AS k, executed_by AS label, status FROM ranked UNION ALL SELECT 'environment', COALESCE(environment, ''), COALESCE(environment, ''), status FROM ranked UNION ALL SELECT 'round', CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN '1' WHEN rn = 2 THEN '2' ELSE '3+' END, CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN '1' WHEN rn = 2 THEN '2' ELSE '3+' END, status FROM ranked ) SELECT dim, k, MAX(label) AS label, status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM facts GROUP BY dim, k, status

WITH ranked AS ( SELECT r.id AS id, r.case_id AS caseId, r.status AS status, r.note AS note, r.executed_by AS executedBy, r.executed_by_user_id AS executedByUserId, r.environment AS environment, r.bug_task_id AS bugTaskId, r.created_at AS createdAt, c.title AS caseTitle, c.case_no AS caseNo, bt.title AS bugTaskTitle, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.case_id ORDER BY r.created_at, r.id) AS rn FROM test_case_run r JOIN test_case c ON c.id = r.case_id AND c.workspace_id = r.workspace_id LEFT JOIN task bt ON bt.id = r.bug_task_id AND bt.workspace_id = r.workspace_id WHERE r.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND c.req_id = #{reqId} ) SELECT id, caseId, caseTitle, caseNo, status, note, executedBy, environment, bugTaskId, bugTaskTitle, createdAt, rn AS round, CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN '1' WHEN rn = 2 THEN '2' ELSE '3+' END AS roundKey FROM ranked WHERE (#{dim} = 'executor' AND COALESCE(executedByUserId, '') = #{key}) OR (#{dim} = 'environment' AND COALESCE(environment, '') = #{key}) OR (#{dim} = 'round' AND (CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN '1' WHEN rn = 2 THEN '2' ELSE '3+' END) = #{key}) ORDER BY createdAt DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
